missing_helper_build: Renderer could not see added core methods; compiled/packaged core lacked them despite source changes. Copied build state suspected, root cause not established; deleting isolated build state restored correct compilation.
truncated_archive_build: jarJar rejected a 10,192,270-byte Vulkan dependency lacking a ZIP central directory. Header/tail/hash retained; cause unresolved. Clean serial build passes six CRCs and class identities; not claimed as an underlying bug fix.
wrong_world_native: First attempt used a fresh directory without the named reference world, stayed at DisconnectedScreen and timed out. Excluded. Corrected retry briefly overlapped its final shutdown; neither is timing/performance evidence. Final sessions run sequentially. Missing-world preflight now rejects before launch.
phase_only_prototype: Six base pixel pairs passed, but diagnostic mip controls later exposed stripes. Superseded; not final acceptance.

implicit_mip_controls.scope: Actual shader/mip sampler diagnostic; other one-unit differences reflect rounding at the mip boundary.
